title: clamp01 is defined in the spawn_fx feature file but consumed only by view.odin's core node-drawing procs
evidence:
spawn_fx.odin:506-507:
// clamp01 — the shared alpha/scale clamp (spawn-fx + the wash/chip fade).
clamp01 :: proc(x: f32) -> f32 {

view.odin:1041 (draw_building):
	sprite_blit(&v.sprites, idx, c, target, {255, 255, 255, u8(255 * clamp01(reveal_fade))})
view.odin:1182 (draw_family_wash):
	c.a = u8(f32(fam.a) * clamp01(fade))
view.odin:1212 (draw_type_chip):
	fade := clamp01(reveal_fade)
detail: The generic clamp helper's only call sites are view.odin's central drawing procs; spawn_fx.odin itself never calls it despite its comment. Extracting/removing the spawn-fx feature later breaks core node drawing.
recommended_fix: Move clamp01 to view.odin beside the other shared drawing helpers (hud, pulse_read) and fix its comment; keep spawn_fx.odin self-contained.

title: draw_ring_annulus copies the 36-entry SPAWN_RING_TABLE inside the per-segment loop — 36 struct copies per ring draw
evidence:
for i in 0 ..< SPAWN_RING_SEGS {
		j := (i + 1) % SPAWN_RING_SEGS
		table := SPAWN_RING_TABLE // local copy — a constant can't be indexed by a runtime index
		a1 := table[i]
		a2 := table[j]
detail: The 288-byte local copy executes per segment iteration (36× per ring, 2 rings per telegraph frame). The harness builds with -debug (no optimization), so the copies genuinely run in the golden path.
recommended_fix: Hoist `table := SPAWN_RING_TABLE` above the for loop — one copy per call, identical semantics (the constant-indexing workaround still satisfied).

title: Single telegraph slot assumes terminal_spawn_interval_ticks >= SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS + SPAWN_BURST_TICKS (18); catalog only enforces >= 1
detail: If interval <= 18, the next window's prediction (successful replace OR honest-negative clear) lands while the current burst (T..T+8) is still drawing — the ring restarts or vanishes mid-burst. Unreachable at shipped 80, but the knob is playtest-tunable (already moved 40->80 this wave).
recommended_fix: Document/enforce the invariant: validate interval >= SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS + SPAWN_BURST_TICKS at load, or only replace/clear the telegraph when the new window's timeline start exceeds the current one's end.
